notes.title: Game release date is revealed!
notes.notes: [h1]⚔️ [b]Mark your calendars: September 23rd[/b] ⚔️[/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1653230?"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]The battle begins.[/h2][p][/p][p]This is the [b]first fully playable version[/b] of Guild & Gals—with [b]17 unique characters[/b] to master and [b]20+ missions[/b] packed with chaos, challenge, and ridiculous fun.[/p][p][/p][p]But this is just the start. notes.title: Heartbreaking Update 💔
notes.notes: [p]I never thought I’d be writing this. After years of pouring my soul into this game, sacrificing time, energy, and so much of myself… Steam has decided my Early Access release can’t go forward under their new policy.[/p][p]This isn’t my choice — it’s theirs. And it feels like the rug has been pulled out from under me, right when I was finally ready to share this dream with you all.[/p][p]Now I’m left with two painful options:[/p][p]• Release the game as it is — rough, barebones, unpolished, but at least real. Full version that will be updated along the way with patches and new content.[/p][p]• Delay the launch — polish it further, but force everyone to wait even longer.[/p][p]Neither feels good. But I need to know what [i]you[/i] think. After all, this game wasn’t made in a vacuum — it was made with the hope that others would experience it, too.[/p][p]I wish I could give you better news. But at the very least, I want to be honest.[/p]

notes.title: Release roadmap
notes.notes: [h1]Release Roadmap[/h1][p][/p][p]I'm happy to tell my plans for the release of the game and my development roadmap.[/p][p][/p][h2]Early Access[/h2][p][/p][p]I'm planning on Early Access to be ready by [b]September. [/b]I will tell specific dates when things are ready. The game will be fully beatable at this point.[/p][p][/p][h2]Full release[/h2][p][/p][p]Full release of the game will be the [b]first quarter of 2026.[/b] As with Early Access, I will tell specific dates upon closer time when it's ready.[/p]
